scripts.fix: find .git/objects/ -type f -empty | xargs rm; git fetch -p; git fsck --full
scripts.dev: concurrently -k --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta --timestamp-format "[HH:mm:ss]" "npm run dev --prefix ./server" "npm run dev --prefix ./client"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix ./server && npm install --prefix ./client
scripts.audit: npm audit fix && npm audit fix --prefix ./server && npm audit fix --prefix ./client
scripts.go: concurrently -k --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta --timestamp-format "[HH:mm:ss]" "cd go-server && air" "npm run dev --prefix ./client"
